A full card image with Decipher's 2002 errata text set into the card and no errata mark, from the Players Committee's online card gallery at swccgpc.com; the earliest saved copy is from 18 December 2007.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-letthewookieewin-PC-Errata-2007-gallery-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Let The Wookiee Win]]: The game text changes: “"dejarik battle,"” becomes “battle at a holosite,”; “If a Wookiee survived a battle you just lost, deploy” becomes “Play”; “one” becomes “an”; “present.” becomes “present with your Wookiee that just participated in a battle you lost.”. A full card image (367 × 506 pixels) with Decipher's corrected text set into the card and no errata mark.

The whole printed card image and the whole 2007 gallery card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
